name: Elisa Dolittle Naruse
original_name: エリサ・D(ドリトル)・鳴瀬
source:
She transfers to Kirameki High School in the protagonist's second year. Although she has blond hair and blue eyes, she is a half-blooded Japanese born in Miyagi Prefecture. She is very interested in the Japanese culture and is very skilled in Kendo. [url=/c1686]Fumiko Yanagi[/url] is her best friend.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tokimeki_Memorial_4]Wikipedia[/url].]
